simple jeera aloo recipe | cumin potatoes

3

for boiling:

  • ▢ 3 potato, peeled and cubed
  • 2 cup water

for tempering:

  • 2 tbsp oil
  • 1 tsp cumin seeds
  • 1 pinch hing
  • few curry leaves
  • ½ tsp turmeric
  • 1 tsp chilli powder
  • salt, to taste
  • 2 tbsp coriander leaves, finely chopped
  • firstly, in a pressure cooker take 3 potato and 2 cup water. pressure cook for 2 whistles.
  • once the pressure releases, drain the potatoes.
  • now in a kadai heat 2 tbsp oil and add 1 tsp cumin seeds, pinch hing and few curry leaves. allow to splutter.
  • add ½ tsp turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder. saute on low flame for 30 seconds.
  • add the potatoes and salt. mix and fry on medium flame for 5 minutes or until crisp.
  • finally, garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.
